title: Commonly Confused English Words: an open dataset (Lexkite)
description:
82 groups of English words that learners often mix up (affect/effect, borrow/lend, lie/lay…). Each group lists every word with its part of speech, a short English definition, an original example sentence, a typical mistake with its correction and a memory tip.

Built by the Lexkite Editorial Team from Lexkite's own editorial content; contains no user data. Latest version: https://lexkite.com/en/research/confused-words/

Limitations: this is an editorially curated list, not a measured frequency of learner errors.
